reviewer.label: construction-review
reviewer.freshness: Fresh assignment, separate from both implementers and Lead independent validation; read-only review

scope: Bounded AE-17/18 constructor and completed dependency-free synthetic managed delivery; not comprehensive lifecycle or multi-task runtime acceptance
reconstructed_flow: CLI -> strict schema/maps/ownership/DAG -> bounded explicit UTF-8 retrieval/hash -> self-contained assignment. No supplied-command execution, persistence, dispatch or routing.

optional_findings.finding: Final verification JSON alone does not identify canonical cwd/run/task. Current identity is reconciled separately in Lead evidence.
optional_findings.next_action: If selected, add canonical workspace and run/task identity to report, test wrong identity and reopen affected review. Not required for current accepted bounded contract.

documented_limits: Stable caller-controlled filesystem; no sandbox/alias isolation
No authoritative dependency-completion reader or multi-task scheduling
reviewer_inspected_not_rerun: Constructor/control source and recorded 19/19 constructor checks
Recorded 5/5 gate controls and 6/6 behavioral checks
Call maps, referenced source symbols and local navigation
reviewer_validation_limits: Reviewer permitted only read-only Git Bash; Node checks and full structural/external-link validation not rerun. Lead independently executed applicable Node/types/structural checks before review and will validate final documentation updates.
hash_provenance: Lead computed these hashes immediately after review resolved and before documentation checkpoint updates; reviewed source/artifacts unchanged during independent review.
review_resolution: All direct assignments resolved; Lead resumes integration. No code or artifact repairs required. Documentation-only checkpoint updates do not change reviewed architecture.
